_schema: off-market-deal-finder scoring shared adjustments v2.0. Applied by scripts/score_leads.py after per-class factor points are computed from the class JSON. Class files never restate anything in this file.
governing_event_rule: For each event-driven factor, the basis multiplier is the minimum multiplier across the events that contributed points. A Verify — Ambiguous flag on any contributing event forces 0.40.

tier_bands.requires: any dated PRESSURE event inside horizon

deal_size_fit.description: Deal-size fit is a multiplier on the total score, never a weighted factor. Measured against unit_range and price_or_value_band from the run config.

mission_fit_affordable.description: Class affordable_regulated only. When the run config programs filter is set and the property's programs do not intersect it.

noi_source_weight.description: Applied inside class 2/3 refinance-gap factors, not to the total.

suppressions.effect: all DEBT-family factors score 0; REGULATORY, OWNERSHIP, TAX_LIEN, PHYSICAL, OPERATING factors unchanged

suppressions.condition: on_market == true (active listing found by deal-finder dedupe)
NOD_RESCISSION after NOD_RECORDED, or Reconveyance closing the only HARD_DISTRESS event
suppressions.effect: remove the HARD_DISTRESS event (status RETIRED); UNENCUMBERED keeps the lead as route watch with signal unencumbered

routing_rules.condition: any of TRUSTEES_DEED, RECEIVER_APPOINTED, SPECIAL_SERVICING present AND equity_cushion_pct <= 0 (or unknown with TRUSTEES_DEED)
ROFR_RECORDED present OR hud_contract == 'Project Rental Assistance Contract' OR programs contains PRAC
assumable_debt == true AND rate_spread_bp > 150 AND no HARD_DISTRESS event
routing_rules.effect: signals += assumption_play; route assumption_play when no other PRESSURE route applies

routing_rules.condition: score < 30 AND any dated PRESSURE event inside horizon

caps.condition: every governing event has basis PROXY
caps.label: proxy-only

caps.condition: no DEBT-family and no REGULATORY-family event inside horizon
programs contains LIFT or extended-use end > 30 years out

decay.description: Events older than 180 days count at 50% in stacking factors, except permanent states.

stacking_rules.independence: Families count once each. Assessor-derived facts (HOLD_YEARS, ABSENTEE_TIER, TAX_DELINQUENT_YEARS from the same roll) count as one family contribution. Recorder documents and court records are independent legs.

evidence_rule.description: Every factor stores evidence[] (event ids with date, basis, source), reading (one line: how the seller-side decision maker experiences it) and lever (approach angle). A factor with empty evidence scores 0 regardless of band match.
